description: Read the secret access log: who read which credential, when, and WHAT FOR. Append-only — entries cannot be changed or deleted, not even by this application. Optional filters: provider, outcome ('gewaehrt'|'verweigert'|'nicht_hinterlegt'|'fehler'), since (ISO), limit. Values are never logged, only that an access happened.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

outcome.description: Filter by outcome: gewaehrt, verweigert, nicht_hinterlegt or fehler

provider.description: Only entries for this credential provider/field

since.description: Only entries from this point in time on (ISO 8601)

name: list_secret_access
